Cue.description: A cue (title) that dialogue can start from or jump to

Dialogue line.description: A line of dialogue spoken by a character

Responses.description: A set of player responses with nested branches

Response with jump.description: A response that jumps to a cue

Conditional response.description: A response that is only available when the condition is true

Jump and return.description: Jump to a cue, then return here when it ends

If / else.description: Conditional block with an else branch

If / elif / else.description: Conditional block with elif and else branches

While.description: Loop while the condition is true

Mutation.description: Mutate state or call a method

Inline mutation.description: Mutation that runs as the text is typed out

Inline condition.description: Show text only when the condition is true

Inline condition with else.description: Show one text or the other depending on the condition

Interpolation.description: Insert the value of an expression

Import.description: Import cues from another dialogue file

Using.description: Use an autoload as a state shortcut for this file

Next.description: Automatically continue after N seconds (or auto)

Line ID.description: Static translation key for a line
